author: jracer15
body:
Welcome to Utopia!

For your consideration for map acceptance is Utopia!  A future themed walls with cool aspects to change up the gameplay! There is teleportation devices in the quad to get to different places and bow shots been modified to have primed TNT effect(no damge or block damage from it)! And in case your wondering wheres the survival aspects no worries, the caves is its own world where the lower class are forced to live under upper class which includes its own underground rail road!
This how the teleporters look like:
Download with YML!  https://www.dropbox.com/sh/1rihi4ilmbh4wgu/AABBDDjTSXJSN37XboM2Byjta

More Pictures:  
http://imgur.com/a/9Sa3L#0

Leave your thoughts on it below!
I suggest downloading the map to really have a feel for it!

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
The area around the map looks quite flat and doesn't allow much conflict between others. I would say to maybe add some land layers and spruce up the gameplay.
It doesn't seem like there's lots of "stuff" in the map, as if it's structures, trees and more as the map seems kind of empty. Add more detailing to the buildings, try making the trees seem more natural and make the map seem inspirational. These are just some ideas to make more gameplay and aesthetics in the map. Hope this helped.

replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
Looks too flat, simply, blocky and lacks structures. You mentioned there is an underground part however that doesn't seem like enough to me... There is a sole structure and the rest of the map is just glass, glowstone and double stone slabs. I don't find the map quite interesting at all, you should add more structures, a more natural feeling to the map, there's a lot you can do in a walls map.
I wish you the best of luck in this, futuristic themed maps are hard!

replies.author: jracer15
replies.body: Its fine, its hard to please people, especially the great people of avicus.  I'm not going lie I don't have a eye for detail.  I don't anyone would care if I left avicus, but that's ok.  I understand a future theme maps wouldn't work and I'm probably always going to make bad maps.  But I won't give up, I'll get better, I'll learn the roots.  I won't be that guy on the avicus forums no one cared about.  I will gain a reputation, idk what it will be yet, but it will be something.  Maybe it is map making, I'm not sure, I've kept lying to myself that I'm some brilliant map maker but I'm truly not.  I'm going to keep trying to make walls maps and I'm going to get better.
